partner: Oh, the bottle trick with the tiny hole—that’s clever. I’ve seen that before but never tried it. I do have a couple of big yogurt tubs, so I might just go with the sacrificial container since it’s easier to refill. Less risk of clogging than poking holes in a bottle cap. And yeah, mulch would help, but I don’t have any on hand right now. Anyway, thanks—this gives me a couple of options that won’t cost me anything.
response:
You're welcome! Since you don't have mulch, remember that even a simple layer of dry grass clippings or even just a layer of dry, fallen leaves spread lightly around the base of your plants will help shade the soil and slow down that rapid drying effect, which is a free "mulch" alternative.

If you decide to use the **"Sacrificial Bucket"** method, just remember to place that bucket/container as close to the plants as possible to keep the water right where the roots need it most! Enjoy the rest of your trip!
